flaws: keeps his true self safe and loses to those willing to risk themselves

relationships.stella-vermillion: Targeted as Desperado mother-body for reincarnating the Tyrant's soul; later possessed her body and was expelled.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Regards him as similar in concentration and present-focused effort, then imitates a future completed Ikki through Perfect Fortune.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Underestimated her as Ikki's support, but she destroys his temporary body and defeats his possession plan's assumptions.
relationships.edelweiss: Had tried to bury her and Nango at the US base; she tracks his conspiracy and arranges the final counterattack.
relationships.fu-xiaoli: Kills his true brain-body in Yellowstone, denying his self-deification.

periods.summary: Eilands reveals that the Abraham project failed because clones lack ego and cannot grow into true Desperados. He therefore intends to use Tyrant's Device Blutsauger as soul-material and Stella as an exceptional mother-body for a perfect human, first deleting Stella's personality with drugs, oxygen control, machinery and Abraham's Mind Control. When the rescue team invades, he relies on mercenaries, EDY units, Abrahams, Darwin and his own cell magic. His Perfect Fortune copies an ideal future Ikki's body and swordsmanship, nearly killing Ikki, but he loses his Japanese temporary body when Shizuku stabs his heart and detonates his blood. His true brain is elsewhere, so he uses Darwin cells in Stella to possess her, devastate the lab and threaten the rescuers. After Ikki and Stella expel Darwin, Eilands attempts from Yellowstone to seize nuclear weapons and force Japan/Vermillion to surrender Stella, but Fu Xiaoli destroys his huge exposed brain with stolen dragon flame. He dies as an ordinary loser, not a god.

key_events.summary: Explains the perfect-human plan and starts deleting Stella's personality.
Transforms into an ideal future Ikki and nearly defeats Ikki through Perfect Fortune.
Uses Darwin cells to control Stella's body and blast away the laboratory.
Attempts nuclear coercion from Yellowstone but is burned to death by Fu Xiaoli.
